L3·N10797unmasked layer
Fires on word-piece fragments inside unusual/transliterated proper names — typically the syllable that completes a surname or place name (Har|**ra**, Gulm|**arg**, Bood|**h**oo, Zargham **O**'Boyle) — plus the token " name" in "my name is"; closely similar name-fragments (arg, ree, or, dam) drive it strongly negative.
